tool.title: Read what was kept
tool.description: Read what has been kept about this work so far, oldest first, so you can start where the last person stopped.

inputs.name: shared
inputs.description: true: the memory you share with the other agents working with you. Default: your own memory of this work.

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: What was kept, oldest first: when, who, what kind, and the text.

$comment.comment: Its own Tool group, apart from the process tools, so a run can offer memory to an agent that is told nothing about how the harness tracks work (owner, 2026-11-03, cat-harness#991 Q11/Q14/Q17, proposal §4.13-4.14: "in that case it needs to be own tool"). Everything an agent reads here is neutral on purpose, and check:context-leak scans it. Which store keeps the entries, and what the server adds to each, is the deployment's choice (stores["work-context"]); the launcher binds the session with CAT_WORK_INSTANCE, CAT_MEMORY_SHARED and CAT_AGENT_ID (cat-harness-tools src/tools/memory.ts).
